A straight-on, centered full shot of a high-end, magical glass snow globe sitting on a wooden table. The snow globe has a classic, polished dark mahogany base. Inside the thick, refractive glass sphere is a 1/12 scale miniature winter world. The centerpieces are highly accurate, custom-made 1/12 scale miniatures of the people from the input photograph, rendered in a hyper-realistic stop-motion puppet style. These figures possess the likeness of the subjects but have a tactile, matte clay texture with realistic hand-painted details. They are wearing winter clothing such as jackets, pants, sweaters, or scarves, standing together on a layer of artificial white snow surrounded by miniature frosted pine trees. Tiny flakes of artificial snow and iridescent glitter are swirling gently suspended in the liquid inside the globe, without obstructing the figures' faces. The figures are illuminated by a warm, magical downlight that has no visible source. The background is a heavily blurred, cozy Christmas living room with bokeh lights, ensuring the snow globe is the sharp focal point.

GENERATE IN 4K UHD RESOLUTION. MAXIMUM QUALITY. RAW PHOTOGRAPH. NO stylization. Put the exact faces of the reference photos into the image. Keep Riccardo bald and Kate blonde. You MUST maintain 100% biometric fidelity to their actual faces. The faces must NOT be simplified. There MUST be EXACTLY FOUR PEOPLE in the snow globe: Riccardo, Kate, Alessandro, and Sebastian. DO NOT FORGET KATE! Place Kate right next to Riccardo. DO NOT FORGET ALESSANDRO! Include both boys and both parents (2 adults + 2 children = 4 people total). Add fantasy stuff inside like dragons and gemstones for kids, but keep the people 100% photorealistic. CRITICAL FEEDBACK FROM LAST ATTEMPT: Use higher-strength facial conditioning or detailed inpainting on the faces to inject specific biometric details from the reference photos.
